name: Motor Driven Cycle
description: A motor vehicle with a seat or saddle on no more than three wheels and a motor of 50 cc or less, motor scooters and motorized bicycles included; the statute measures the motor only by displacement, so for an electric scooter or moped the working limits are the General Regulation's 50 km/h motor and 55 kg weight caps. New Brunswick has no e-bike category: its bicycle is human-powered only, so an e-bike is a motorized bicycle here.

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle and no more than three wheels; the statutory limit is a motor of 50 cc or less, with no wattage equivalent
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, RSNB 1973, c M-17, s. 1

restrictions.rule: Weighs 55 kg or less, with wheel rims at least 25 cm in diameter, a seat 70 cm off the ground and an automatic transmission
Its motor can't propel it faster than 50 km/h
Needs one to three white headlamps and a red tail lamp visible from 150 m, and can't exceed 60 km/h at night unless its headlamp lights 100 m ahead
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, RSNB 1973, c M-17, ss. 145, 209; General Regulation, N.B. Reg. 83-42, s. 46

restrictions.rule: The rider has the rights and duties of a motor vehicle driver
Riders need a licence for motor-driven cycles, available from age 14; Class 9 covers it, as do Classes 5 and 6
Every rider must wear a motorcycle helmet
No passengers, and no riding abreast another motor-driven cycle except to pass
Registered with one plate, for $33 a year, and must carry motor vehicle liability insurance
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, RSNB 1973, c M-17, s. 17.1; General Regulation, N.B. Reg. 83-42, ss. 5, 45

restrictions.rule: Can be banned from controlled-access roadways by the authority responsible for them
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, RSNB 1973, c M-17, s. 160

restrictions.rule: Bill 113 (royal assent June 10, 2022), which would let regulations bring other devices into the bicycle definition, comes into force only on proclamation, and hadn't been proclaimed as of the Act's June 12, 2026 consolidation
